name: Axolotl
summary: Apache-2.0 post-training / fine-tuning framework for a wide range of LLMs, with CLI, YAML configs, Docker and distributed-training options.
description: Established open-source trainer (axolotl-ai-cloud/axolotl; not archived). PyPI axolotl 0.21.1 and docs https://docs.axolotl.ai verified 2026-11-10. README documents uv-based install (example: uv pip install axolotl[deepspeed] after a pinned torch) and Docker as a less error-prone path. Apache-2.0 software; GPUs, model licenses and any Axolotl Cloud/hosted extras are separate. Not presented here as a brand-new product launch.

agent_access.notes: Local/Docker install from PyPI or the repository. Cloud GPUs and model access are configured separately.
